GPU 運算資源排程

GPU Compute Orchestration

自主研發 · 互動技術展示

以合成工作比較 FIFO 與回填策略，觀察 CPU、VRAM 限制如何改變佇列。

討論 GPU 資源管理及效能工程 操作 GPU 排程展示

產業問題與工程挑戰

共享運算環境若同時有多個工作，必須兼顧資源需求、等待順序與資源利用。 一個排在前方的大工作可能阻擋後方能先執行的小工作。提高利用率的同時，還要理解不同工作的等待代價。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

以同一批合成工作、各工時和可用資源執行確定性模擬。FIFO 尊重佇列次序，回填允許符合當下容量的後續工作先開始。

成果

展示可比較等待中的工作、已模擬排入的時段、無法排入的工作及模擬資源使用。

  • 可重現的單機排程試驗
  • 工作佇列、狀態與排程時間軸
  • 供選型討論的資源配置方式

驗證與證據

以工作開始、完成、排入與未排入狀態驗證模擬，並檢查同時執行的工作是否超過設定的 CPU 與 VRAM 上限。時間採模擬步數。

  • 操作 GPU 排程展示
  • GPU 運算基礎設施服務

Technical Note

GPU Compute Orchestration

Independent Research and Development · Interactive Demonstration

Compare FIFO and backfill with synthetic jobs and inspect how CPU and VRAM limits affect the queue.

繁體中文 Run the GPU scheduling demo

Industry problem and engineering challenge

A shared compute environment must balance resource demands, queue order and resource usage when several jobs arrive together. A large job at the head of the queue can block smaller jobs that fit the currently available resources. A policy should make the waiting trade-offs visible.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

The same synthetic workload runs deterministically under the configured limits. FIFO respects job order. Backfill lets a later job start when it fits current capacity.

Outcome

Compare pending jobs, simulated time slots, jobs that cannot fit, and simulated resource use.

  • Reproducible single-machine scheduling experiment
  • Queue, job status and timeline
  • Resource configuration for engineering discussion

Validation and evidence

Check whether jobs start, finish or cannot be admitted, and verify that concurrent jobs respect the configured CPU and VRAM limits. Time is expressed as simulation steps.

  • Run the GPU scheduling demo
  • GPU compute infrastructure services

Project status and disclosure

Ownership and status
Independent Research and Development · Interactive Demonstration

This independent demo uses synthetic jobs and a single-machine model. Resource use, waiting and the timeline are simulated. No physical GPU or enterprise workload is queried.
